info.title: Dossier API
info.description: The Dossier sync + tracking contract. Implement this spec to build a Dossier-compatible backend the extension and web app can point at. Authenticate at POST /api/authenticate, then send the access token as a Bearer token on every protected request; refresh it at POST /api/refresh.

Off pauses every existing consultant share link of the organization's resumes right away (they open nothing, not even a hint); on restores those not revoked or expired meanwhile. One ORG_SETTINGS audit row when the value changed (old, new, linksPaused or linksRestored).

post.description: roles.manage at ORG scope. Body: name, description?, templateKey? (a system template other than OWNER) or sourceRoleId? (duplicate), permissions? (the whole set: [{key, scope, ceilingRoleKey?, rowFilter?}]). Every row must be within the caller's own permissions (422 ROLE_CEILING {key, scope}); 409 ROLE_NAME_TAKEN; 422 ORG_LIMIT_REACHED. 404 for anyone without the permission, when the roles flag is off, or for another organization's source role.

post.summary: Restore a role to the rows of its template
post.description: roles.manage at ORG scope, If-Match required. Show GET .../diff first. Writes one ROLE_RESYNC audit row (HIGH) with what changed back; nothing when already identical. 422 when the role has no template; 422 ROLE_CEILING when the role holds anything the caller does not; 409 ROLE_SYSTEM for a template.

get.description: Paged, server-driven table. Needs resumes.view_for; the rows are only the consultants inside the scope it is held at. Query: tab (all, pending, recent), q (2 to 80 characters: resume, file, target role, headline, consultant, email or skill), departmentId, visibility (INTERNAL, PUBLIC, PRIVATE), status (APPROVED, PENDING, REJECTED), primary (true or false), ownerId, consultantId, updated (days, 1 to 365), sort=field,dir (consultant, name, role, version, modified, created, status, size; 400 SORT_INVALID otherwise; default modified,desc), page (from 0), size (1 to 100, default 25). Answers a page and X-Total-Count.

post.description: Body: consultantId, name, fileName? (a plain label, no folders), targetRole?, headline?, summary?, visibility? (default INTERNAL), experience[] (title, employer, startYear, endYear). Needs resumes.edit_for covering the consultant. The record starts PENDING at version 1, not primary, owned by the caller. No file is stored. Text containing a never-collected value is 422 SENSITIVE_CONTENT. Idempotency-Key required. One RESUME_CREATE audit row.

post.summary: Approve, reject or reopen a resume
post.description: Body {decision: APPROVE|REJECT|REOPEN, note?}. Needs resumes.approve_request. APPROVE and REJECT apply to a PENDING resume (409 NOT_PENDING) and are refused for the person who prepared it (422 SELF_DECISION). REOPEN puts a decided resume back to PENDING (the Undo). One RESUME_APPROVE / RESUME_REJECT / RESUME_REOPEN audit row.

Body {ids (1 to 100), action: VISIBILITY|APPROVE|REJECT|REOPEN, visibility?}. VISIBILITY needs resumes.edit_for, the others resumes.approve_request. Each resume is applied or skipped with a reason (NOT_FOUND, UNCHANGED, NOT_PENDING, SELF_DECISION, NOT_APPROVED); previous is the value an Undo puts back. One audit row per change plus one RESUME_BULK row. Idempotency-Key required.

get.description: q (title, client, location or skill; 2 to 80 characters) and these repeatable filters (repeat the parameter; a comma is never a separator): status (OPEN, IN_REVIEW, ON_HOLD, FILLED, CLOSED), priority (LOW, NORMAL, HIGH, URGENT), workMode (REMOTE, HYBRID, ON_SITE); clientId; assigned (ANY: a consultant was put forward, NONE: nobody yet); aging=true (open and older than the organization's aging days). sort (posted, due, priority, title, client, status, age; 400 SORT_INVALID otherwise) and dir; page (from 0), size (1 to 100, default 10). Answers a page and X-Total-Count.

post.description: requirements.manage. Body: title and clientId (required, a client of this organization), contactId, description (the client's text, up to 4000 characters), location, workMode, employment, durationLabel, experienceLevel, rateMin and rateMax (whole currency units, business data), rateUnit (HOUR or YEAR), positions, status (OPEN, IN_REVIEW or ON_HOLD; default OPEN), priority (LOW, NORMAL, HIGH, URGENT; default NORMAL), dueOn, skills[] (at most 15), source (MANUAL, PASTED_TEXT: description is required, LINK: sourceUrl is required). A client that already has a live requirement with the same title and location, or the same posting link, is 409 REQUIREMENT_EXISTS (with existingId). An Idempotency-Key is required. Free text goes through the sensitive-data scanner (422). Audit JOB_CREATE and REQUIREMENT_INTAKE.

post.summary: Put a requirement in front of a consultant

post.description: groups.manage. parentGroupId puts a TEAM under a DEPARTMENT (422 GROUP_PARENT_INVALID for anything else); leadMemberId must be an ACTIVE member (422 LEAD_NOT_ACTIVE). 409 GROUP_NAME_TAKEN, 422 ORG_LIMIT_REACHED.

post.summary: Move people into a group (one or many)
post.description: groups.manage. Body {memberIds[] (at most 500)}; Idempotency-Key required. One result row per id: MOVED, UNCHANGED, or SKIPPED NOT_FOUND (not a live seat of this organization or not one the caller may touch). A team move also sets the team's department.

post.summary: Hide an alert for 7 days (for the caller only)
post.description: alertKey is one of the alert keys of the dashboard (ORG_PAST_DUE, DOMAIN_FAILING, DOMAIN_SUSPENDED, INVITES_EXPIRING, MEMBERS_SUSPENDED, SINGLE_ADMIN, BRANDING_DRAFT, APPLICATIONS_OVERDUE, LICENSES_ATTENTION, MARKETERS_OVERLOADED, APPLICATIONS_NEW, INTERVIEWS_WEEK, PLACEMENT_NEW, RESUMES_PENDING, CONSULTANTS_UNASSIGNED) or CHECKLIST (the activation checklist card). Other administrators still see it. Unknown key, or no dashboard.view_org: 404.

get.description: Paged, server-driven directory. Needs consultants.view. Query: q (name, email, title, location or skill; 2 to 80 characters), availability (AVAILABLE, ON_PROJECT, NOTICE, UNAVAILABLE), skill (exact), license (ACTIVE, EXPIRING, PENDING, NEEDS_REVIEW), marketerId (a seat id, or none for unassigned), workMode (REMOTE, HYBRID, ONSITE), status (ACTIVE default, INACTIVE), departmentId, sort=field,dir (repeatable; name, experience, availability, license, profile, joined; 400 SORT_INVALID otherwise), page (from 0), size (1 to 100, default 10).

post.description: consultants.edit. Body: displayName, email (unique per organization: 409 CONSULTANT_EXISTS), jobTitle, yearsExperience, locationLabel, workMode, skills[] (the first two are the primary chips), departmentGroupId. Free text goes through the sensitive-data scanner (422). Idempotency-Key required. One CONSULTANT_CREATE audit row. Answers 201 with the detail.

post.summary: Save a job for an assigned consultant
post.description: Body: {company, roleTitle, jobUrl?, location?, externalJobId?, atsPlatform?, postingId?}. Creates the application on the CONSULTANT's tracker with status SAVED, source org, history 'Updated by <marketer> on behalf of <consultant>'; a job the consultant already has keeps its status (alreadySaved = true). Needs member.act_for and an active assignment; 404 for anything else; 429 over 30 saves a minute. Never submits.
consultants.edit. Body: reason (optional). One CONSULTANT_REACTIVATE audit row.

post.summary: Link a consultant profile to an organization member
post.description: consultants.edit. Body: memberId (an ACTIVE or INVITED member of this organization with no profile: 422 / 409 MEMBER_ALREADY_LINKED; the consultant must not be linked yet: 409 CONSULTANT_ALREADY_LINKED). Their sign-in then opens the consultant workspace. One CONSULTANT_UPDATE audit row.

assignments.manage (a TEAM holder may only name marketers inside their team). Body: marketerMemberId (an ACTIVE seat with marketer capacity: 422 MARKETER_INVALID), backupMemberId, priority. One CONSULTANT_ASSIGN audit row when the marketer changes.
consultants.edit. Body: reason (10 to 500 characters). The consultant leaves the default list and every KPI. One CONSULTANT_DEACTIVATE audit row.

get.description: Applications of the consultant (newest stage change first) and their upcoming interviews.

post.summary: Create a job application for a consultant
post.description: opportunities.manage. Body: requirementId (an OPEN job: 422 JOB_NOT_OPEN; 409 APPLICATION_EXISTS). Creates the application in stage ASSIGNED with its CREATED event and marks the match ASSIGNED. Idempotency-Key required. One APPLICATION_CREATE audit row. Answers 201.
consultants.edit. Body: ids, action (DEACTIVATE or REACTIVATE), reason (10 to 500 characters to deactivate). Idempotency-Key required.

post.summary: Assign one marketer to many consultants
post.description: assignments.manage. Body: ids, marketerMemberId. Idempotency-Key required. One CONSULTANT_ASSIGN row per changed consultant plus one CONSULTANT_BULK row.

post.summary: Set the availability of many consultants
post.description: consultants.edit. Body: ids (1 to 200), availability. Idempotency-Key required. One CONSULTANT_UPDATE row per changed consultant plus one CONSULTANT_BULK row.

post.summary: Mark as viewed (ASSIGNED to VIEWED). Explicit; a GET never does it.
End the link between this opportunity and my tracked application
Ask the marketer a question (1 to 500 characters); the opportunity becomes NEEDS_INFO
Link one of MY tracked applications to this opportunity (applicationId required). Accepts an Idempotency-Key.
Decline: reason NOT_INTERESTED, LOCATION, RATE, ALREADY_APPLIED or OTHER, optional note (200 characters)
I applied (my own application, in my own session). Optional applicationId ties one of MY tracked applications to it (404 for anyone else's). Accepts an Idempotency-Key.

get.description: Server-driven directory. Query: q (name, industry or account manager; 2 to 80 characters), and these repeatable filters (repeat the parameter; a comma is never a separator): industry, health (HEALTHY, AT_RISK, NEUTRAL: computed from rows by the organization's thresholds), status (ACTIVE, PROSPECT, INACTIVE), sizeBand, managerId; sort (name, industry, requirements, consultants, manager, health, activity; 400 SORT_INVALID otherwise) and dir (asc or desc, default newest first); page (from 0), size (1 to 100, default 10). Answers a page and X-Total-Count.

post.description: clients.manage. Body: name (required, unique per organization, 409 DUPLICATE_CLIENT), industry, website, location, sizeBand (1-50, 51-200, 201-1000, 1000-5000, 5000+), clientSince (a date), about, status (ACTIVE or PROSPECT, default ACTIVE), ownerMemberId (an active member; default the caller). An Idempotency-Key is required: the same key and body returns the first answer. Free text goes through the sensitive-data scanner (422). Audit CLIENT_CREATE.

clients.manage. Body: body (1 to 1000 characters, through the sensitive-data scanner). Idempotency-Key optional. Audit CLIENT_NOTE_ADD (the audit row never carries the text). Answers the client detail.

post.summary: Add a contact to a client
post.description: clients.manage. Body: name (required), title, email (a WORK address: consumer mail domains from the organization setting are 422 WORK_EMAIL_REQUIRED; the same e-mail twice is 409 DUPLICATE_CONTACT), role (HIRING_MANAGER, RECRUITER, VMS_ADMIN, AP, OTHER). Idempotency-Key optional. Audit CLIENT_CONTACT_ADD. Answers the client detail.

post.summary: Copy a published version into the draft (does not publish)

post.description: Validates everything, makes the draft live, appends a version, bumps config_version. 409 BRANDING_NOTHING_TO_PUBLISH when the draft equals what is live.

post.summary: Throw the draft away (back to what is live); writes no audit row
Upload a logo, favicon or banner into the draft
post.description: multipart field 'file'. PNG, JPEG or WebP only (magic bytes decide); SVG and anything else -> 415 BRANDING_ASSET_UNSUPPORTED_TYPE; over the size cap -> 413 BRANDING_ASSET_TOO_LARGE; too small -> 422 BRANDING_ASSET_TOO_SMALL; not an image or not square (favicon) -> 422. PNG/JPEG are re-encoded (metadata stripped).

delete.summary: Remove the logo, favicon or banner from the draft

get.description: Paged, server-driven table. Query: q (2 to 80 characters: job title, consultant, client, application code, stage or next action), stage (repeatable or comma separated: ASSIGNED, SUBMITTED, UNDER_REVIEW, INTERVIEWING, OFFER, CLOSED), jobTitle, clientId, marketerId, from and to (applied date, yyyy-mm-dd), sort=field,dir (applied, job, consultant, client, stage, nextAction, moved; 400 SORT_INVALID otherwise), page (from 0), size (1 to 100, default 10). Answers a Page and X-Total-Count.

post.description: Body: requirementId, consultantId, optional marketerMemberId (default: the consultant's assigned marketer), source, nextAction, nextActionDue, appliedOn, stage (ASSIGNED, or SUBMITTED when the consultant already submitted it). 409 DUPLICATE_APPLICATION for a second application of the same consultant to the same job. Idempotency-Key honoured. One APPLICATION_CREATE audit row.

Body: stage (the stage it is now in) with closedReason (HIRED, REJECTED, WITHDRAWN, NO_RESPONSE) when closing; or undoEventId (from the detail's undo token) to revert your own latest move. A stage change records what happened: Kiwiply never submits an application. 422 INVALID_TRANSITION (with the allowed stages) for a move backwards or out of Closed. Idempotency-Key honoured.
Body: body (1 to 1000 characters, no sensitive identifiers). One NOTE event and one APPLICATION_NOTE audit row. Idempotency-Key honoured.
Revoke the supplied refresh token (and its rotation family) server-side. Always returns 200.

Legacy (shared-account) organizations: signed in; becomes a member and records the consent choice (NONE or SUMMARY) with the text version. SEPARATE organizations (decision O4): no sign-in, the invite token is the credential; the body carries the new password, the person's enterprise account of that organization is created (or reused) and, on the organization's own host, the response carries its tenant-bound session. 409 ALREADY_MEMBER, INVITE_EXPIRED or SEAT_STATE.

get.description: No authentication. 404 for an unknown or revoked code, 409 INVITE_EXPIRED when it has expired or has no places left.

post.description: Signed in. Same as accepting an invite, for a join link a cohort shares. Members only.

post.summary: Save a job to the board
post.description: Creates (or updates, by the board's dedup) a SAVED application from the stored posting. Returns {applicationId}.

post.summary: Hide a job or a company
post.description: {signal: HIDE|HIDE_COMPANY}. The job (or every job of that company) stops showing in the user's search; hiding a saved job archives its application (archivedApplicationId, for Undo).
For the authenticated user, issue a fresh access + refresh token pair in a NEW rotation family, for the browser extension. Requires a valid access token.
For an enterprise account's session: a one-time connect code (60 seconds, single use) as a link on the platform host. 404 for personal accounts and anything else.

post.summary: Exchange a connect code for an enterprise extension session
post.description: Public. Single use, 60 seconds, rate limited. Returns the token pair (tid + ext=1) and the account; the same empty 401 for every failure.
Receives Stripe events. Verified by signature; 400 when it doesn't match, 500 to ask Stripe to retry.
Creates a Stripe Billing Portal session and returns its URL.
Creates a Stripe Checkout Session for the chosen plan and returns its URL.

get.description: 204 if the bearer token is valid, 401 otherwise.

post.description: Exchange username + password for a short-lived access token and a long-lived refresh token.
Exchange a valid mfaToken + emailed code for the token pair.
Issue the normal access + refresh token pair for a demo account. 403 DEMO_DISABLED while the demo is off; 404 for any other login.
Verify a Google ID token and exchange it for our access + refresh tokens (find-or-create by verified email).

delete.description: Permanently erases the current user's resumes (files + rows), bio, applications, AI answers, field cache, and the user account.

get.description: Name, target, tags, primary, lifecycle, role, lineage, visibility, version and PDF state. 404 if not owned.

patch.summary: Change a resume's metadata
patch.description: Body {name?, target?, tags?, primary?, starred?, archived?, shareWithOrg?}; only the fields sent change. 422 META_INVALID (blank or over-long name, over-long target, more than 10 tags or one over 24 characters), 409 PRIMARY_REQUIRED (unsetting the primary, or archiving it while other live resumes exist).

patch.summary: Change a resume's theme
patch.description: Body {theme} (accent, fontPair, spacing, pageSize, dateStyle, showPhoto, fit{mode,target,step}, _touched): bounded fields only, at most 8 KB; 422 THEME_INVALID {path, message}. Does not change the content, writes no version row and bumps doc_version (the ETag).

patch.summary: Switch a resume's template
patch.description: Body {templateId, theme?}; 422 DOC_INVALID for an unknown or disabled id. Applies the new template's theme defaults to the theme keys the user has not touched (or stores the given theme verbatim), writes a TEMPLATE_SWITCH version row and queues the PDF at once. Does not change the fillable content.

delete.description: Idempotent: 204 whether or not it was already revoked. 404 if the resume or the grant is not yours.

patch.summary: Change a share link
patch.description: Body {allowDownload}: allow or stop PDF download on a live link without changing its address. 404 if the resume, or a live link of it, is not yours; 422 ACCESS_INVALID without allowDownload.

get.description: NONE / DRAFT / FINISHED, the persona, the draft summary (its state only with ?include=state), the dashboard card decision and the completeness thresholds. A dismissed card that comes back is counted once per showing.

patch.summary: Set the persona / act on the dashboard card
patch.description: persona: a string sets it, null clears it, absent leaves it (422 PERSONA_INVALID). card.action: SNOOZE, DISMISS or RESET.

get.summary: One role with its permission rows and its version (ETag)
get.description: The ETag is what edit and delete expect as If-Match.

delete.description: roles.manage at ORG scope, If-Match required. 409 ROLE_IN_USE {count} while a live member holds it; 409 ROLE_SYSTEM for a template; 422 ROLE_CEILING when the role holds anything the caller does not.

patch.summary: Rename a role or replace its permission set
patch.description: roles.manage at ORG scope. If-Match: the version (ETag) the editor last saw: 428 PRECONDITION_REQUIRED without it, 412 PRECONDITION_FAILED {currentVersion} when stale. A system template is 409 ROLE_SYSTEM (clone it first). Everything in the role, before and after, must be within the caller's own permissions (422 ROLE_CEILING {key, scope}).

get.description: Facts, the client text, the consultants it was put in front of, and an ETag (the version PATCH expects as If-Match). 404 for another tenant's id.

patch.summary: Edit a requirement (autosave) or move its status
patch.description: requirements.manage. Body: any of title, description, location, workMode, employment, durationLabel, experienceLevel, rateMin, rateMax, rateUnit, positions, filled, status (OPEN, IN_REVIEW, ON_HOLD, FILLED, CLOSED), contactId, skills, priority, dueOn (a JSON null clears a clearable field); any other key is 422. If-Match is required: 428 without, 412 when stale. Filling or closing a requirement closes the assignments still open on it. Answers the new detail.

delete.summary: Delete one of your own open tasks
delete.description: Someone else's task is 404; a completed task is refused (422).

patch.summary: Edit a task
patch.description: Only the fields sent change. status COMPLETED stamps completed_at; moving a completed task to another status reopens it.

patch.summary: Record where the submission stands
patch.description: submissions.record. Body {status: SUBMITTED|CLIENT_REVIEW|INTERVIEW_REQUESTED|REJECTED, note?}: a fact reported by the consultant or the client; it submits nothing.

patch.summary: Configure a stream
patch.description: Partial update of name, description, schedule, keywords, client scope. Unknown or other-tenant id: 404. matches.run.

patch.summary: Toggle or edit a stream rule
patch.description: ruleKey: DEFAULT_KEYWORDS | CLIENT_MAPPING | DUPLICATE_DETECTION | AUTO_PUBLISH. Body {enabled?, value?}. matches.run.

get.description: Headline, summary, skills (primary first), experience and the change history. 404 for a consultant outside the caller's scope.

patch.summary: Edit a resume's metadata (a new version)
patch.description: Body: any of title, headline, summary, targetRole (a JSON null clears all but title); other keys 422. resumes.edit_for (ASSIGNED). A real change bumps the version, goes back to PENDING approval when it was approved, writes a change-log row and one audit row; a request that changes nothing writes none.

patch.summary: Move or clear the next action date.
Tick or untick one checklist item
Update a follow-up's status
patch.description: PENDING, IN_PROGRESS, SCHEDULED, NOT_STARTED, WAITING or COMPLETED (completing stamps completed_at). Logs a STATUS_CHANGED event.

patch.summary: Set (or clear, with an empty text) the next action and its due date (followups.manage).
Mark a logged activity COMPLETED, SCHEDULED or CANCELLED
patch.description: Only manual rows (id of MANUAL:n); a source-derived line is not editable (404).

get.description: Seat, roles, department, team, manager, direct reports, consent scope, what the caller may do with this seat (actions), and recent audit rows about the person (with audit.view or hr.view). phone, location and timezone are null: the platform stores none of them for a member. Never exposes a resume or an application. ETag = the version PATCH expects as If-Match. 404 outside the caller's scope.

patch.summary: Edit one employee
patch.description: Body: any of title, departmentGroupId, teamGroupId, managerMemberId (a JSON null clears it); any other key is 422. Title, department and team need members.group.set, the manager needs members.manager.set, each at a scope covering the person. If-Match (the sheet's ETag) is required: 428 without, 412 when stale. 422 TEAM_NOT_IN_DEPARTMENT, MANAGER_CYCLE, MANAGER_INVALID; a group or manager of another organization is the generic 404. One audit row per changed field family; a request that changes nothing writes none. Answers the new detail.

patch.summary: Rename a resume or change its visibility
patch.description: Body: {name?, visibility?} with visibility INTERNAL, PUBLIC or PRIVATE. Names are scanned for never-collected personal data (422).

patch.summary: Change a marketer's capacity, status or title
patch.description: assignments.manage at a scope covering the marketer. Body: any of capacity (1 to 200), status (ACTIVE or PAUSED), title. One MARKETER_UPDATE audit row when something changed.

get.description: Facts, description, skills, client contact, every match with its score and status (Top Matches), the submissions (applications) and the activity (application events and audit rows). ETag = the version PATCH expects as If-Match. 404 for another tenant's id.

patch.summary: Edit a job (autosave)
patch.description: requirements.manage. Body: any of title, description, location, workMode, employment, durationLabel, experienceLevel, rateMin, rateMax, rateUnit, positions, filled, status, contactId, skills (a JSON null clears a clearable field); any other key is 422. If-Match (the drawer's ETag) is required: 428 without, 412 when stale. A request that changes nothing writes no audit row. Audit JOB_STATUS (status) and JOB_UPDATE (the rest). Answers the new detail.

patch.summary: Dismiss or restore a suggested match
patch.description: opportunities.manage. Body: status = DISMISSED or SUGGESTED (the Undo). 409 MATCH_STATE for an assigned match. Audit JOB_MATCH_DISMISS / JOB_MATCH_RESTORE. Answers the job detail.

get.description: Stepper of rounds, timeline, feedback, documents, interviewers, meeting details, what the caller may do (actions) and, for a few minutes after the caller's own latest status change, an undo token. 404 outside the caller's scope.

patch.summary: Edit next step, notes, meeting link, mode, location or interviewers
patch.description: interviews.coordinate. Body: any of nextStep, notes, meetingLink, mode, location, interviewers (a JSON null clears a clearable field); any other key is 422 FIELD_UNKNOWN. A request that changes nothing writes no event and no audit row.

get.summary: One group with its people and teams (ETag)
get.description: The ETag is what update and delete expect as If-Match. Enterprise flag only; the people are limited to what the caller's scope reaches.

delete.description: groups.manage. Inside the Enterprise flag only when empty: 409 GROUP_NOT_EMPTY {count, members, teams}; If-Match required. Never removes a person.

patch.summary: Rename, retype, re-parent, change the lead, status, icon or colour of a group
patch.description: groups.manage. If-Match is required inside the Enterprise flag (428 without, 412 {currentVersion} when stale). Moving a team under another department re-points its members' department in the same transaction. clearParent / clearLead remove them.

get.description: Overview data, checklist, marketer, what the caller may do (actions). ETag = the version PATCH expects as If-Match. 404 outside the caller's reach.

patch.summary: Edit one consultant
patch.description: consultants.edit. Body: any of jobTitle, yearsExperience, locationLabel, workMode, availabilityStatus, availableFrom, licenseStatus, licenseValidUntil, departmentGroupId (a JSON null clears a nullable one); any other key is 422. If-Match (the drawer's ETag) is required: 428 without, 412 when stale. One CONSULTANT_UPDATE audit row; a request that changes nothing writes none.

get.description: Facts, about, health with the rule's sentence, contacts, requirements, recent submissions and relationship notes. ETag = the version PATCH expects as If-Match. 404 for another tenant's id.

patch.summary: Edit a client (autosave)
patch.description: clients.manage. Body: any of name, industry, website, location, sizeBand, clientSince, about, status (ACTIVE, PROSPECT, INACTIVE), ownerMemberId (a JSON null clears a clearable field); any other key is 422. If-Match (the drawer's ETag) is required: 428 without, 412 when stale. A request that changes nothing writes no audit row. Audit CLIENT_STATUS (status) and CLIENT_UPDATE (the rest). Answers the new detail.

patch.summary: Edit a contact, or mark one as left (and back)
patch.description: clients.manage. Body: any of name, title, email, role, status (ACTIVE or LEFT); any other key is 422. Audit CLIENT_CONTACT_UPDATE. Answers the client detail.

patch.summary: Edit the draft (partial)
patch.description: Body: any of primary, secondary, accent (#rrggbb, white text must reach 4.5:1 -> 422 BRANDING_COLOR_LOW_CONTRAST with a suggestion), theme, welcomeTitle, welcomeMessage, supportEmail, terminology, navPrefs; null clears a field. If-Match: the draftVersion the editor last saw (409 BRANDING_DRAFT_CONFLICT when stale).

get.description: Stepper with the date each stage was recorded, the timeline, notes, activity, the fields of Application Details, what the caller may do (actions) and, for a few minutes after the caller's own latest stage move, an undo token. 404 outside the caller's scope.

patch.summary: Edit the next action, its due date or the marketer
patch.description: Body: any of nextAction, nextActionDue (yyyy-mm-dd) and marketerMemberId (a JSON null clears each); any other key is 422 FIELD_UNKNOWN. Changing the marketer needs assignments.manage. A request that changes nothing writes no event and no audit row.

Web only: resumes where I hold a USER grant, plus (when the org area is in play) those of members who gave me FULL scope.
Limits, score weights, templates, feature switches, plan and resume cap for the signed-in user. ETag = sha256 of the body; Cache-Control private, max-age=60.

My interviews in a date range

get.description: text/calendar (iCalendar) with a VTIMEZONE for the interview's zone (UTC when none); attachment named interview-<id>.ics. 404 if not owned.

get.summary: Jobs the mail shows that the board doesn't track

get.description: All learned field answers owned by the current user.
Score out of 100, the parts and their weights, and the highest-weight missing part as nextAction.

Every history row of one of my applications, newest first (id breaks a tie), as {items, total, page, size}. hash.description: Render hash of the stored PDF (null when there is none).

generatedAt.description: When the stored PDF was generated.

pollMs.description: Editor endpoints only: milliseconds between status polls.

pollWindowMs.description: Editor endpoints only: how long after the last save to keep polling, in milliseconds.

doc.description: The ResumeDocument (schema v2; a stored v1 document is upgraded on read).

schemaVersion.description: The schema of 'doc' - always 2 (the current ResumeDocument schema).

theme.description: Theme overrides (colors, font, spacing); {} for the template defaults.

renderHash.description: Hash of what the PDF would be rendered from now: sha256(contentHash|templateId|canonical theme). The stored PDF is current when pdf.hash equals it.

score.description: The last Resume Score the editor's server-side scorer stored (DESIGN 11.5); null until the first scored save.

state.description: The web's SetupState (candidates, decisions, cursor); never the file or the raw text.

hash.description: The content hash of the document that was exported (ResumeDocDTO.contentHash).

name.description: Optional name for this version (at most 80 characters); without it the checkpoint is unnamed.

email.description: The email of a Kiwiply account.

role.description: VIEW (the default); EDIT is not available yet.

expiresAt.description: When the grant ends; omitted = it does not expire.

label.description: A note for yourself, at most 80 characters.

paused.description: True while the owner's organization has consultant sharing off: the grant is kept but opens nothing (it can still be revoked) and works again when sharing is back on.

expiresAt.description: When the link stops working; omitted = resume.share.linkDefaultDays from now (0 = never).

label.description: A note for yourself, e.g. 'Sent to recruiter at Acme' (at most 80 characters).

allowDownload.description: May the holder download the PDF? Omitted = resume.share.allowDownloadDefault.

templateId.description: An enabled template id (setting resume.templates.enabled); the configured default (modern) when omitted.

target.description: Free label for the role this resume targets (meta.target).

label.description: The resume's name; defaults by source: the target / 'My resume', the file name, '<from> (copy)'.

source.description: Where the content comes from: 'profile' (default), 'scratch', {kind:'upload', structured, bio?, fileName, keep?} or {kind:'copy', fromResumeId}.

theme.description: Optional exact theme to store instead of the template defaults (the editor's undo/redo of a switch).

allowDownload.description: May the holder of this link download the PDF?

persona.description: student | first_job | switching | experienced, or null to clear.

scope.description: NONE | SUMMARY | FULL: what the member lets their organisation see.

pairedWith.description: The paired marketer / coach, when there is one.

shareWithOrg.description: This resume's 'include with my organisation' switch.

shareLinks.description: Share links are on (feature.resume_share_links.enabled); the header hides Shared with Recruiters when off.

weights.description: {skills, title, years, industry, education}; sums to 100.

stepSeconds.description: Step key (hello, source, review, skills, you, prefs) to seconds.

copy.description: Copy deck key to a string or an array of strings.

onboarding.description: Onboarding v2 tunables (R1.8): the dashboard card, the time estimates, the draft cap, the payoff.

capabilities.description: What this builder session may do (personal, consultant inside an organization, or a marketer acting for a consultant). The web hides controls from it; the API refuses the same actions.

bands.description: Bands [{min, title, body}], highest min first.

overrides.description: Per-template partial TemplateCapabilities; may only tighten.

popular.description: Template ids in the order the Popular Templates strip shows them first (resume.templates.popular).

Slice.description: A count by a named bucket.

StageRow.description: enteredThisWeek / enteredLastWeek: applications that entered the stage in the last 7 days and the 7 days before; deltaPct is null when last week was 0.

WeekPoint.description: One week (starting Monday): value is the main count, second the comparison count (see the report).

bearer-jwt.description: JWT access token issued by POST /api/authenticate (or refreshed via POST /api/refresh).
